items.name: Data-center/power-plant gas service contract additions, Texas
items.claim: Energy Transfer disclosed that two customers recently added a combined 100 MMcf/d of natural gas service capacity under existing contracts serving power plant and data center sites in Texas.
items.source_excerpt: Energy Transfer recently had two customers add a combined 100 MMcf/d to their existing contracts for natural gas services to their power plant or data center sites in Texas.

notes: Q2 2026 8-K earnings release is the only stored evidence for Energy Transfer. It discloses a specific, dated gas-supply contract expansion tied to power plant/data center demand (the chain's gas-supply-and-interconnection link) but no aggregate backlog or RPO figure.
